messages:
ella: quick sync — opened PR #5123 to add APAC region endpoint + data residency notes. spotted two small mismatches: the HTTP header we call `X-Redwood-Region` in the docs but the SDK snippet still uses `region` param. can we standardize?

sam: yep saw that. the runtime accepts both (we added a compatibility shim) but we should pick one canonical name in docs. prefer `X-Redwood-Region`? that's what infra uses for routing. :+1:

michael: +1 for header. also flagging hk residency — legal asked to clarify that HK logs are retained in the region only for Private deployments, hosted still routes through our eu region when eu is chosen. we should avoid implying full multi-region isolation for hosted.

jen: re: SDK snippet — i can update the python/js examples. for Python i'd propose:```python
# set region via header
import requests
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer $TOKEN", "X-Redwood-Region": "ap-sg"}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", headers=headers, json={"model": "redwood-1.0", "input": "hi"})
print(resp.json())
```

sam: looks good. for node folks we can show the `region` field too but note it's legacy:```js
// legacy param, prefer header for clarity
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1.0', input: 'hi', region: 'ap-sg' })
```

ella: i added a short caveats bullet in the residency section but need wording check. current draft: "Hosted API routes data to the nearest compliant region; logs and operational telemetry for hosted products may be processed outside the selected region. Dedicated and Private deployments offer region-local processing and retention per contract." is that accurate?

michael: tweak: "Hosted API: request routing aims for regional locality but hosted operational telemetry and backups may be stored outside the selected region. Dedicated and Private: region-local processing and retention options available under contract." keeps it clearer.

jen: will update PR text and push a small SDK snippet change. also adding an inline note: :link: add link to residency policy (internal) — /docs/compliance/residency-policy (we need a public-facing link; l10n-bot, can you suggest?)

l10n-bot: auto-suggest: use /residency/overview (public) and /residency/private for enterprise specifics. Also flags: translations pending for zh-HK and en-AU.

ella: great — can someone add a quick migration note in the SDK migration guide (tiny section, "Header-preferred region config")? we should call out the compatibility shim and timeline for removing `region` param (if any).

sam: i'll add the migration note and call out deprecation as: "No planned removal — kept for backward compat, but header is recommended."

jen: pushing update to PR now with the python/node snippets and changed residency wording. @ella if you can quick review i'll merge after CI passes.

ella: reviewing now. thanks everyone! :wave:
